question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device that receives an IP address but cannot reach the internet.
expected_answer: You check gateway reachability verify DNS settings and test routing paths

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a switch port that shows link but no data flow.
expected_answer: You check VLAN assignment inspect port configuration and test with another device

question_text: Describe how you identify a network loop.
expected_answer: You look for high CPU on switches check spanning tree status and trace redundant connections

question_text: Explain how you diagnose intermittent WiFi drops.
expected_answer: You check signal interference review channel usage and test access point load

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot slow network performance.
expected_answer: You test latency measure bandwidth check congestion and inspect cabling quality

question_text: Explain how you identify a DHCP issue.
expected_answer: You check scope availability verify server reachability and confirm correct relay configuration

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a device that cannot reach a specific internal resource.
expected_answer: You check firewall rules verify routing and confirm the resource responds to network requests

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a VLAN mismatch.
expected_answer: You compare switch port settings check trunk configuration and verify tagging on connected devices

question_text: Describe how you identify a failing network interface.
expected_answer: You test throughput monitor errors and swap the interface to confirm the issue

question_text: Explain how you diagnose packet loss on a wired connection.
expected_answer: You test cable integrity check switch logs and monitor for errors on the interface
